title: Cutscene Fix
description: Fixes pre-rendered cutscenes that stay black while the audio plays. Every story cutscene is a 4K video above the Windows H.264 decoder's limit; this switches each to the game's own 1080p copy, in sync with the voices. Every other video is left alone.

settings.label: Enabled
settings.help: Off: every video plays as the game picks it.

settings.label: Keep picture in sync
settings.help: Moves the 1080p copy to where the original would be, so the picture matches the voices. Turn off if the picture jumps at the start of a cutscene.

settings.label: Detailed log
settings.help: Writes every video checked, not just switched ones, to the UE4SS log.

settings.label: Forget remembered videos
settings.help: Videos a game update adds and the mod finds too high are remembered in known_bad.txt and switched at once next time. This empties that list. The game's own cutscenes are built in and always switched.
